name: CNJ Comunica PJe / DJEN (Diario de Justica Eletronico Nacional)
tier_rationale: Government body (A8 trusted): the National Council of Justice runs the national electronic justice gazette (DJEN, CNJ Resolucao 455/2022) through the Comunica PJe portal and API; P362 provider tier trusted.

reliability.justification: Official court communications (intimacoes, citacoes, editais) published by the courts themselves; CloudFront geo-blocks non-Brazilian egress, so outside Brazil the answer is 'could not verify', never 'no communications' (P362 cond 3).

djen_api.title: CNJ DJEN / Comunica PJe public API (court communications by text, tribunal and date window; parameters unverified outside Brazil)

terms.quote: The Comunica PJe API terms were not readable from the research egress (CloudFront 'configured to block access from your country' on the API and swagger; the portal reset the connection), so terms='unknown' until legal records them (official communications under CNJ Resolucao 455/2022).

djen_api.notes: Research C0770 (HTTP 403 CloudFront geo-block, 2026-11-25/26): endpoint https://comunicaapi.pje.jus.br/api/v1/comunicacao?texto=&siglaTribunal=&dataDisponibilizacaoInicio=&dataDisponibilizacaoFim=&itensPorPagina=&pagina= to be confirmed from the team's Brazilian network (P362 cond 1 build gate). Disabled in every licence profile until legal records the terms (unknown). requires_egress BR (A9): a CloudFront 403 'block access from your country' is BLOCKED geo_block, never 'no communications', no retry with other headers. Texts name natural persons: CNPJ/company queries by default, person names only on explicit due diligence, never employee or candidate screening (LGPD). Used by djen_court_communications (manual link to comunica.pje.jus.br meanwhile).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G10-3 (P362 djen_court_communications); id from the registrable domain pje.jus.br (CNJ's own provider 'cnj' belongs to batch p2-G10-2 for DataJud). No quota block: the CloudFront limits are unknown and the module sends no request until the build gate is met; min_interval 2 s and no automatic retries (A9: never retried with other headers).
